name: Qwen3 Coder 30B (LM Studio)
description: Local LLM opponent via LM Studio's OpenAI-compatible server. Each decision it sees a short text summary of the position and up to 24 candidate moves (pre-ranked by Greedy v1) and answers with a move number. Falls back to Greedy v1 if LM Studio is off or the answer is not a valid number.
